payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all pairs of promo codes, compute Hamming distance, find minimum distance d, then determine maximum k using conditional thresholds or n=1 edge case.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively compares all pairs, which is a brute-force complete search. Among the given subtypes, 'search_backtracking' is the least mismatched, though no recursive backtracking is used.
